new_authority: Independent-laboratory cellular signaling domain; temporal/local transport evaluation

schema_finding: Two MATLAB examples contain nuclear coordinates, bPAC labels and nuclear masks; they do not contain a complete matched ERK trajectory/stimulus table. Whole-cell membrane contacts cannot be inferred from nuclear masks.
license_caution: No repository code license detected; do not relicense or redistribute as MIT.

series: 6 synchronization channels, 10 entrainment channels; one sheet per condition
stimulus: Green intervals annotated in hours; background red light, not binary dark/blue assay
limitations: The workbook covers figures 4b and 5e. Do not claim that figure 6c half-frequency single-cell traces are present. Small number of experiments; no population-wide inference.

design: 119 optogenetic input conditions; single-cell flow cytometry endpoints
limitation: Independent cells at snapshots are not longitudinal trajectories; cannot reuse temporal early/late calibration unchanged.

evidence: Article explicitly states no data deposited in external repositories; supplemental material may support narrower analyses. No author contact performed.
Nascent transcription and light control are relevant; a public machine-readable matched input/trajectory repository was not located in this search. This is not a proof of nonexistence.
